biocs.name: Uncommon net localgroup command execution
biocs.description: Detection of net.exe being executed with localgroup argument outside of expected context
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\net.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'localgroup'
| filter not (causality_actor_process_image_name in ('explorer.exe', 'services.exe', 'svchost.exe'))
